checks.rule: Ankle ball is a proportional sphere at the common measured pivot
checks.input: Fit the actual rest ball surface independently and compare it with both socket centres and the existing foot pivot.
checks.expected: 115 mm radius; common centre within 0.02 mm; diameter is 75–100% of the original 256 mm calf diameter.

checks.rule: Ball, foot and calf remain closed outward-facing finite surfaces
checks.input: Virtually weld coincident seam vertices, count directed edge incidences, Euler characteristic and signed volume.
checks.expected: Every edge has two opposing faces; Euler characteristic 2 and positive volume for each piece.

checks.rule: Both spherical sockets closely cradle the actual ball
checks.input: Inspect every advertised true cavity vertex and its normal at rest, independently of the stored radius.
checks.expected: 0.6 mm radial clearance within 0.002 mm, inward-facing cavity normals and coincident independently fitted centres.

checks.rule: Socket construction preserves the sole, toe shape and upper calf
checks.input: Compare original sole/toe positions and original reference-calf upper-profile vertices with actual new geometry.
checks.expected: Sole and all toe vertices at or past z=0.145 remain unchanged; foot X/Z bounds and contact points are preserved; upper calf profile still matches.

checks.rule: Both cups stay seated through combined ankle, roll, heel and toe poses
checks.input: Sweep the 16 combined limit corners and 128 deterministic intermediate poses; independently fit transformed spherical surfaces.
checks.expected: Both socket centres remain within 0.02 mm of the ball and radial clearance stays within 0.002 mm of 0.6 mm.

checks.rule: Spherical cuff openings retain clearance at the maximum combined bend
checks.input: Measure the angular envelope of roll × (ankle + heel) over all limit corners, allowing a 5 mm lip on both cups.
checks.expected: 45° caps and their lips cannot meet, including the measured-safe composed bend and 20° roll.

checks.rule: Combined bend rejects the measured unsafe 66° request while preserving doubled ankle motion
checks.input: Request isolated ankle extremes and the old 48° ankle + 30° heel combination; inspect the applied shared mechanical contract.
checks.expected: Isolated -36° and +48° remain available; composition never exceeds the measured-safe 60° envelope.

checks.rule: The complete foot and calf surfaces stay outside the ankle sphere
checks.input: Measure the nearest point of every actual shell triangle to the ball centre at rest and the largest combined bends.
checks.expected: No hidden outer-blend or triangle penetration; all faces retain positive clearance beyond a 0.01 mm numerical tolerance.

checks.rule: Actual foot and calf shells do not intersect at the safe movement extremes
checks.input: Test every vertex in both directions against the other actual closed shell with indexed face-ray probes and nearest-surface confirmation.
checks.expected: Zero vertices penetrate the other shell by more than 0.01 mm, including 60° composed bend and ±20° roll.

checks.rule: Toe-only motion leaves the calf rigid and repeated poses return exactly to rest
checks.input: Apply a toe-only pose, then repeated limit corners and restore zero pose.
checks.expected: Toe bending never changes calf positions/normals; rest restores every mesh buffer and placement bit for bit.
